sbar.situation: The bank system has recovered. The recovery check ran four looks, and the last two in a row at 65 s were clean.
sbar.background: The gateway stopped answering, so payments and screening traffic fell to 0/s. Clearing kept crashing on queue item 94 with a JSONDecodeError in parse, and the reconciliation session held a write lock on the ledger.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander restarted the gateway, which worked. Its first attempts to quarantine item 94 and restart clearing failed because the ledger was locked. It then ended the reconciliation session, quarantined item 94 and restarted clearing, and all three succeeded.
sbar.recommendation: Watch the gateway, clearing and the ledger, and check that the reconciliation batch that was ended is rerun or completed. The operations team has been asked (soon) to review item 94 from clearing, then either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer, because that payment has not been cleared.
